Real grounded combat walk: frame 1 right-foot-forward contact; 2 weight transfer; 3 left foot passing; 4 left foot swinging forward; frame 5 opposite contact with left foot forward/right foot behind; 6 weight transfer; 7 right foot passing; 8 right foot swinging into frame 1.
